notes: Ph.D. in Engineering with concentration in Mechanical Engineering.

deadline.value: Department does not specify a separate closing date; applicants should apply at least six to nine months prior to enrollment.
deadline.quote: Applicants should apply to a graduate degree program at least six to nine months before the beginning of the semester in which they plan to enroll. Most departments require earlier submission of credentials for acceptance to their program. Contact the department for specific deadlines.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required, but may be considered if submitted.
gre_general.quote: Official test results: GRE scores are not required for this program, but may be considered if submitted

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no Mechanical Engineering subject test.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Pre-application supervisor requirement is not stated.

funding.value: Graduate assistantships provide regular stipend, graduate health insurance, and tuition support.
funding.quote: Compensation: Regular stipend, graduate health insurance, tuition support, and in select cases, mandatory student fee coverage.

entry_route.value: Admission requires a bachelor's degree from an accredited institution with at least 3.0 cumulative and major GPA.
entry_route.quote: In general, applicants may be admitted to a graduate program if they have a bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution with at least a 3.0 (B) cumulative undergraduate GPA and a 3.0 (B) GPA in their major.
